title: Women’s Triple Jump World Rankings, November 2026
desc: The top ten in the World Athletics women’s triple jump rankings on 17 November 2026. Scores are ranking points based on competition results and placings.

source.name: World Athletics — Women’s Triple Jump World Rankings
source.note: On 22 November 2026 (Korea time), the AllRanks assistant (Codex) checked each name, federation, place and score against the official 17 November 2026 women’s triple jump table. This snapshot covers places 1–10. Ivana Španović ranked tenth with 1,211 points, two points ahead of Sharifa Davronova. Scores combine competition results and placings. The table measures ranking points.
